Ba'azab mein jo "Ba" hai woh bata rahi hai ke yahan fe'l ki tazmeen hai goya ke fe'l muqaddar hai yaani yeh kafir azab ke waqe hone ki talab mein jaldi kar rahe hain, jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Wa yasta'jilunaka bil-azabi wa lan yukhlifallahu wa'dahu, wa inna yawman 'inda rabbika ka-alfi sanatin mimma ta'uddun) (Al-Hajj: 47) yaani yeh azab mangne mein ujlat kar rahe hain aur Allah Ta'ala hargiz waada khilafi nahi karta, yaani iska azab yaqinan apne waqt-e-muqarrarah par aa kar hi rahega, Nasai mein Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A se warid hai ke kafiron ne Allah ka azab manga jo un par yaqinan aane wala hai, yaani akhirat mein un ki is talab ke alfaaz bhi dusri jagah Quran mein naqal hain kehte hain ayat (Allahumma in kana haza huwal-haqqa min 'indika fa-amtir 'alayna hijaratan minas-sama-i aw-itna bi-azabin alim) (Al-Anfal: 32) yaani Ilahi agar yeh tere paas se haq hai toh hum par asman se patthar barsa ya hamare paas koi dardnak azab la, Ibn Jarir waghairah kehte hain ke is se murad woh azab ki wadi hai jo Qiyamat ke din azabon se beh niklegi, lekin yeh qaul zaeef hai aur matlab se bahut dur hai sahih qaul pehla hi hai jis par rawish-e-kalam ki dalalat hai phir farmata hai ke woh azab kafiron ke liye tayyar hai aur un par aapadne wala hai jab aa jayega toh use dur karne wala nahi aur na kisi mein itni taqat hai ke use hata sake. Ayat (Minallahi zil-ma'arij) (Al-Ma'arij: 3)

Al-Ma'arij: 3 ke ma'ani Ibn Abbas (R.A) ki tafsir ke mutabiq darjoun wala, yaani bulandiyon aur buzurgiyon wala aur Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain murad ma'arij se aasmaan ki seedhiyan hain, Qatadah (R.H) kehte hain fazl-o-karam aur na'mat-o-rahm wala, yaani yeh azaab us Allah ki taraf se hai jo un sifton wala hai, us ki taraf farishte aur rooh charhte hain, rooh ki tafsir mein Hazrat Abu Salih (R.H) farmate hain ke yeh aik qisam ki makhlooq hai insaan to nahi lekin insaanon se bilkul mushabih hai, main kehta hoon mumkin hai is se murad Hazrat Jibril (Alaihis Salam) hon aur yeh atf ho aam par khas ka aur mumkin hai ke is se murad Bani Adam ki roohein hon, is liye ke woh bhi qabz hone ke baad aasmaan ki taraf charhti hain, jaise ke Hazrat Bara (R.A) wali lambi hadith mein hai ke jab farishte paak rooh nikalte hain to use le kar aik aasmaan se doosre par charhte jaate hain yahan tak ke saatween aasmaan par pahunchte hain, go is ke ba'z raawiyon mein kalaam hai lekin yeh hadith mashhoor hai aur is ki shahadat mein Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) wali hadith bhi hai jaise ke pehle bi-riwayat Imam Ahmad, Tirmizi aur Ibn Majah guzar chuki hai jis ki sanad ke raawi aik jama'at ki shart par hain, pehli hadith bhi Musnad Ahmad, Abu Dawood, Nasai aur Ibn Majah mein hai, hum ne is ke alfaaz aur is ke turuq ka baseet bayaan aayat (Yuthabbitullahul-lazina aamanu bil-qawlis-sabiti fil-hayatid-dunya wa fil-akhirah, wa yudillullahuz-zalimina wa yaf'alullahu ma yasha') (Ibrahim: 27) ki tafsir mein kar diya hai.

Phir farmaya us din mein jis ki miqdar pachaas hazaar saal ki hai is mein chaar qaul hain:

Aik toh yeh ke is se murad woh doori hai jo asfal-us-safilin se arsh-e-mualla tak hai aur isi tarah arsh ke neeche se upar tak ka fasla bhi itna hi hai aur arsh-e-mualla surkh yaqoot ka hai, jaise ke Imam Ibn Abi Shaibah ne apni kitab Sifat-ul-Arsh mein zikr kiya hai. 

Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain ke is ke hukm ki inteha neeche ki zameen se asmanon ke upar tak ki pachaas hazaar saal ki hai aur aik din aik hazaar saal ka hai yaani asman se zameen tak aur zameen se asman tak aik din mein jo aik hazaar saal ke barabar hai, is liye ke asman-o-zameen ka fasla paanch so saal ka hai. Yehi riwayat doosre tareeq se Hazrat Mujahid ke qaul se marwi hai Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A ke qaul se nahi. 

Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A se Ibn Abi Hatim mein riwayat hai ke har zameen ki motai paanch so saal ke fasle ki hai aur aik zameen se doosri zameen tak paanch so saal ki doori hai toh saat hazaar saal yeh hogaye, isi tarah asman, toh chaudah hazaar saal yeh hue aur satween asman se arsh-e-azeem tak chhattees hazaar saal ka fasla hai. Yehi maani hain Allah ke is farman ke ke "is din mein jis ki miqdar pachaas hazaar saal ke barabar hai."

Doosra qaul yeh hai ke murad is se yeh hai ke jab se Allah Ta'ala ne is alam ko paida kiya hai tab se le kar qiyamat tak ke is ki baqa ki akhir tak muddat pachaas hazaar saal ki hai. Chunacha Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain ke duniya ki kul umar pachaas hazaar saal ki hai, aur yehi aik din hai jo is ayat mein murad liya gaya hai. Hazrat Ikramah farmate hain duniya ki poori muddat yehi hai lekin kisi ko maloom nahi ke kis qadr guzar gayi aur kitni baqi hai siwaye Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala ke.

Teesra qaul yeh hai ke yeh din woh hai jo duniya aur akhirat mein fasle ka hai, Hazrat Muhammad bin Ka'ab yehi farmate hain lekin yeh qaul bahut hi ghareeb hai.

Chautha qaul yeh hai ke is se murad qiyamat ka din hai. Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A se yeh ba-sanad-e-sahih marwi hai, Hazrat Ikramah bhi yehi farmate hain. Ibn Abbas R.A ka qaul hai ke qiyamat ke din ko Allah Ta'ala kafiron par pachaas hazaar saal ka kar dega.

Musnad Ahmad ki hadith mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ se kaha gaya yeh din toh bahut hi bara hai, Aap ﷺ ne farmaya: Us ki qasam jis ke haath mein meri jaan hai yeh momin par is qadr halka hojaye ga ke duniya ki aik farz namaz ki adayegi mein jitna waqt lagta hai is se bhi kam hoga. 

Yeh hadith Ibn Jareer mein bhi hai is ke do rawi zaeef hain, Wallahu A'lam.

Musnad ki aik aur hadith mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Hurairah R.A ke paas se qabeela Banu Amir ka aik shakhs guzra, logon ne kaha Hazrat yeh apne qabeele mein sab se bara maldaar hai. Aap ﷺ ne use bulwaya aur farmaya: Kya waqai tum sab se zyada maldaar ho?

Us ne kaha haan mere paas rang barang saikron oont qism qism ke ghulam aala aala darje ke ghore waghera hain. Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A ne farmaya dekhho khabardar aisa na ho ke yeh janwar apne paon se tumhein rondein aur apne singon se tumhein marein. Bar bar yahi farmate rahe yahan tak ke Aamri ke chehre ka rang ur gaya aur us ne kaha Hazrat yeh kyun? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya suno! Main ne Rasool Allah ﷺ se suna hai ke jo apne oonton ka haq ada na kare un ki sakhti mein aur un ki aasaani mein use Allah Ta'ala Qayamat ke din ek chatil lambe chaure saaf maidan mein chit litaaye ga aur un tamam janwaroon ko khoob mota taza kar ke hukm dega ke ise ronde hue chalo. Chunacha ek ek kar ke ise kachalte hue guzrenge jab aakhir wala guzar jaye ga to awwal wala laut kar aa jaye ga. Yahi azaab use hota rahe ga us din mein jis ki miqdar pachaas hazaar saal ki hai yahan tak ke logon ke darmiyan fasla ho jaye phir woh apna rasta dekh le ga. Isi tarah gaye ghore bakri waghera yahi sing daar janwar apne singon se bhi ise marte jayenge koi un mein be-sing ka ya tute hue sing wala na hoga.

Aamri ne pucha اے Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A farmayiye oonton mein Allah ka haq kya hai? Farmaya miskeenon ko sawari ke liye tuhfatan dena, ghurbat ke sath sulook karna, doodh peene ke liye janwar dena, un ke naroon ki zaroorat jinhein maada ke liye ho na manga hua be-qeemat dena.

Yeh hadis Abu Dawood aur Nisai mein bhi dusri sanad se mazkoor hai. Musnad ki ek hadis mein hai ke jo sone chandi ke khazane wala is ka haq ada na kare us ka sona chandi ki takhtiyon ki soorat mein banaya jaye ga aur Jahannam ki aag mein tapa kar us ki peshani, karot aur peeth daghi jaye gi yahan tak ke Allah apne bandoon ke faisle kar le us din mein jis ki miqdar tumhari ginti se pachaas hazaar saal ki hogi phir woh apna rasta Jannat ki taraf ya Jahannam ki taraf dekh le ga. Phir aage bakriyon aur oonton ka bayan hai jaise upar guzra, aur yeh bhi bayan hai ke ghore teen qism ke logon ke liye hain. Allah Ta'ala hi ko un ki haqeeqat ka ba-khoobi ilm hai main to ba-wajood na janne ke Kitabullah mein kuch kehna makrooh janta hoon.

Ba'azab mein jo "Ba" hai woh bata rahi hai ke yahan fe'l ki tazmeen hai goya ke fe'l muqaddar hai yaani yeh kafir azab ke waqe hone ki talab mein jaldi kar rahe hain, jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Wa yasta'jilunaka bil-azabi wa lan yukhlifallahu wa'dahu, wa inna yawman 'inda rabbika ka-alfi sanatin mimma ta'uddun) (Al-Hajj: 47) yaani yeh azab mangne mein ujlat kar rahe hain aur Allah Ta'ala hargiz waada khilafi nahi karta, yaani iska azab yaqinan apne waqt-e-muqarrarah par aa kar hi rahega, Nasai mein Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A se warid hai ke kafiron ne Allah ka azab manga jo un par yaqinan aane wala hai, yaani akhirat mein un ki is talab ke alfaaz bhi dusri jagah Quran mein naqal hain kehte hain ayat (Allahumma in kana haza huwal-haqqa min 'indika fa-amtir 'alayna hijaratan minas-sama-i aw-itna bi-azabin alim) (Al-Anfal: 32) yaani Ilahi agar yeh tere paas se haq hai toh hum par asman se patthar barsa ya hamare paas koi dardnak azab la, Ibn Jarir waghairah kehte hain ke is se murad woh azab ki wadi hai jo Qiyamat ke din azabon se beh niklegi, lekin yeh qaul zaeef hai aur matlab se bahut dur hai sahih qaul pehla hi hai jis par rawish-e-kalam ki dalalat hai phir farmata hai ke woh azab kafiron ke liye tayyar hai aur un par aapadne wala hai jab aa jayega toh use dur karne wala nahi aur na kisi mein itni taqat hai ke use hata sake. Ayat (Minallahi zil-ma'arij) (Al-Ma'arij: 3)

Al-Ma'arij: 3 ke ma'ani Ibn Abbas (R.A) ki tafsir ke mutabiq darjoun wala, yaani bulandiyon aur buzurgiyon wala aur Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain murad ma'arij se aasmaan ki seedhiyan hain, Qatadah (R.H) kehte hain fazl-o-karam aur na'mat-o-rahm wala, yaani yeh azaab us Allah ki taraf se hai jo un sifton wala hai, us ki taraf farishte aur rooh charhte hain, rooh ki tafsir mein Hazrat Abu Salih (R.H) farmate hain ke yeh aik qisam ki makhlooq hai insaan to nahi lekin insaanon se bilkul mushabih hai, main kehta hoon mumkin hai is se murad Hazrat Jibril (Alaihis Salam) hon aur yeh atf ho aam par khas ka aur mumkin hai ke is se murad Bani Adam ki roohein hon, is liye ke woh bhi qabz hone ke baad aasmaan ki taraf charhti hain, jaise ke Hazrat Bara (R.A) wali lambi hadith mein hai ke jab farishte paak rooh nikalte hain to use le kar aik aasmaan se doosre par charhte jaate hain yahan tak ke saatween aasmaan par pahunchte hain, go is ke ba'z raawiyon mein kalaam hai lekin yeh hadith mashhoor hai aur is ki shahadat mein Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) wali hadith bhi hai jaise ke pehle bi-riwayat Imam Ahmad, Tirmizi aur Ibn Majah guzar chuki hai jis ki sanad ke raawi aik jama'at ki shart par hain, pehli hadith bhi Musnad Ahmad, Abu Dawood, Nasai aur Ibn Majah mein hai, hum ne is ke alfaaz aur is ke turuq ka baseet bayaan aayat (Yuthabbitullahul-lazina aamanu bil-qawlis-sabiti fil-hayatid-dunya wa fil-akhirah, wa yudillullahuz-zalimina wa yaf'alullahu ma yasha') (Ibrahim: 27) ki tafsir mein kar diya hai.

Phir farmaya us din mein jis ki miqdar pachaas hazaar saal ki hai is mein chaar qaul hain:

Aik toh yeh ke is se murad woh doori hai jo asfal-us-safilin se arsh-e-mualla tak hai aur isi tarah arsh ke neeche se upar tak ka fasla bhi itna hi hai aur arsh-e-mualla surkh yaqoot ka hai, jaise ke Imam Ibn Abi Shaibah ne apni kitab Sifat-ul-Arsh mein zikr kiya hai. 

Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain ke is ke hukm ki inteha neeche ki zameen se asmanon ke upar tak ki pachaas hazaar saal ki hai aur aik din aik hazaar saal ka hai yaani asman se zameen tak aur zameen se asman tak aik din mein jo aik hazaar saal ke barabar hai, is liye ke asman-o-zameen ka fasla paanch so saal ka hai. Yehi riwayat doosre tareeq se Hazrat Mujahid ke qaul se marwi hai Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A ke qaul se nahi. 

Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A se Ibn Abi Hatim mein riwayat hai ke har zameen ki motai paanch so saal ke fasle ki hai aur aik zameen se doosri zameen tak paanch so saal ki doori hai toh saat hazaar saal yeh hogaye, isi tarah asman, toh chaudah hazaar saal yeh hue aur satween asman se arsh-e-azeem tak chhattees hazaar saal ka fasla hai. Yehi maani hain Allah ke is farman ke ke "is din mein jis ki miqdar pachaas hazaar saal ke barabar hai."

Doosra qaul yeh hai ke murad is se yeh hai ke jab se Allah Ta'ala ne is alam ko paida kiya hai tab se le kar qiyamat tak ke is ki baqa ki akhir tak muddat pachaas hazaar saal ki hai. Chunacha Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain ke duniya ki kul umar pachaas hazaar saal ki hai, aur yehi aik din hai jo is ayat mein murad liya gaya hai. Hazrat Ikramah farmate hain duniya ki poori muddat yehi hai lekin kisi ko maloom nahi ke kis qadr guzar gayi aur kitni baqi hai siwaye Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala ke.

Teesra qaul yeh hai ke yeh din woh hai jo duniya aur akhirat mein fasle ka hai, Hazrat Muhammad bin Ka'ab yehi farmate hain lekin yeh qaul bahut hi ghareeb hai.

Chautha qaul yeh hai ke is se murad qiyamat ka din hai. Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A se yeh ba-sanad-e-sahih marwi hai, Hazrat Ikramah bhi yehi farmate hain. Ibn Abbas R.A ka qaul hai ke qiyamat ke din ko Allah Ta'ala kafiron par pachaas hazaar saal ka kar dega.

Musnad Ahmad ki hadith mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ se kaha gaya yeh din toh bahut hi bara hai, Aap ﷺ ne farmaya: Us ki qasam jis ke haath mein meri jaan hai yeh momin par is qadr halka hojaye ga ke duniya ki aik farz namaz ki adayegi mein jitna waqt lagta hai is se bhi kam hoga. 

Yeh hadith Ibn Jareer mein bhi hai is ke do rawi zaeef hain, Wallahu A'lam.

Musnad ki aik aur hadith mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Hurairah R.A ke paas se qabeela Banu Amir ka aik shakhs guzra, logon ne kaha Hazrat yeh apne qabeele mein sab se bara maldaar hai. Aap ﷺ ne use bulwaya aur farmaya: Kya waqai tum sab se zyada maldaar ho?

Us ne kaha haan mere paas rang barang saikron oont qism qism ke ghulam aala aala darje ke ghore waghera hain. Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A ne farmaya dekhho khabardar aisa na ho ke yeh janwar apne paon se tumhein rondein aur apne singon se tumhein marein. Bar bar yahi farmate rahe yahan tak ke Aamri ke chehre ka rang ur gaya aur us ne kaha Hazrat yeh kyun? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya suno! Main ne Rasool Allah ﷺ se suna hai ke jo apne oonton ka haq ada na kare un ki sakhti mein aur un ki aasaani mein use Allah Ta'ala Qayamat ke din ek chatil lambe chaure saaf maidan mein chit litaaye ga aur un tamam janwaroon ko khoob mota taza kar ke hukm dega ke ise ronde hue chalo. Chunacha ek ek kar ke ise kachalte hue guzrenge jab aakhir wala guzar jaye ga to awwal wala laut kar aa jaye ga. Yahi azaab use hota rahe ga us din mein jis ki miqdar pachaas hazaar saal ki hai yahan tak ke logon ke darmiyan fasla ho jaye phir woh apna rasta dekh le ga. Isi tarah gaye ghore bakri waghera yahi sing daar janwar apne singon se bhi ise marte jayenge koi un mein be-sing ka ya tute hue sing wala na hoga.

Aamri ne pucha اے Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A farmayiye oonton mein Allah ka haq kya hai? Farmaya miskeenon ko sawari ke liye tuhfatan dena, ghurbat ke sath sulook karna, doodh peene ke liye janwar dena, un ke naroon ki zaroorat jinhein maada ke liye ho na manga hua be-qeemat dena.

Yeh hadis Abu Dawood aur Nisai mein bhi dusri sanad se mazkoor hai. Musnad ki ek hadis mein hai ke jo sone chandi ke khazane wala is ka haq ada na kare us ka sona chandi ki takhtiyon ki soorat mein banaya jaye ga aur Jahannam ki aag mein tapa kar us ki peshani, karot aur peeth daghi jaye gi yahan tak ke Allah apne bandoon ke faisle kar le us din mein jis ki miqdar tumhari ginti se pachaas hazaar saal ki hogi phir woh apna rasta Jannat ki taraf ya Jahannam ki taraf dekh le ga. Phir aage bakriyon aur oonton ka bayan hai jaise upar guzra, aur yeh bhi bayan hai ke ghore teen qism ke logon ke liye hain. Ek to ajr dilane wale, doosri qism ke parda poshi karne wale, teesri qism ke bojh dhone wale. Yeh hadis poori poori Sahih Muslim Sharif mein bhi hai. In riwayaton ke poora bayan karne ki aur un ki sanadron aur alfaaz ke tamam tar naql karne ki munasib jagah ahkaam ki kitab-e-Zakat hai, yahan un ke waarid karne se hamari gharz sirf un alfaaz se hai ke yahan tak ke Allah apne bandoon ke darmiyan faisla kare ga, us din mein jis ki miqdar pachaas hazaar saal ki hai.

Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas R.A se ek shakhs poochta hai ke woh din kya hai, jis ki miqdar ek hazaar saal ki hai? Aap ﷺ farmate hain aur woh din kya hai jo pachaas hazaar saal ka hai? Us ne kaha Hazrat main to khud daryaft karne aaya hoon? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya suno yeh do din hain jin ka zikr Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala ne apni kitab mein kiya hai. Thehre hue beharakat ke pani ko bhi Arab ma'a daim kehte hain, is se sabit hua ki namaz mein itminan wajib hai. Jo shakhs apne ruku sajde poori tarah theher kar ba-itminan ada nahi karta, woh apni namaz par daim nahi kyunki na woh sukoon karta hai na itminan, balkay koye ki tarah thongein maar leta hai, iski namaz isey najat nahi dilwayegi. 

Aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ki is se murad har naik amal par mudawat aur hameeshgi karna hai, jaise ki Nabi Alaihis Salatu Wassalam ka farmaan hai ki Allah ko sab se zyada pasand woh amal hai jis par mudawat ki jaye go kam ho. Khud Huzoor ﷺ ki aadat-e-mubarak bhi yehi thi ki jis kaam ko karte us par hameeshgi karte.

Bas, hey logo! Namaz ko achhi tarah pabandi se padha karo, momin ka yeh zewar aur iska behtareen khuluq hai. 

Phir farmata hai inke maalon mein hajat-mandon ka bhi muqarrara hissa hai, saail aur mehroom ki poori tafseer Surah Zariyat mein guzar chuki hai.

Yeh log amanat ke ada karne wale, waadon aur waidoon, qaul aur qarar ko poora karne wale aur achchi tarah nibahane wale hain, na khiyanat karein, na bad-ahdi aur wada-shikni karein. Yeh apni shahadaton ki bhi hifazat karne wale hain, yaani na is mein kami karein na ziyadati, na shahadat dene se bhagein na use chhupayein, jo chhupa le woh gunehgar dil wala hai.

Markaz-e-Noor-o-Hidayat se mafrour insan: Allah Ta'ala Azzawajal un kafiron par inkar kar raha hai jo Huzoor ﷺ ke mubarak zamane mein the. Khud Aap ﷺ ko woh dekh rahe the aur Aap ﷺ jo hidayat lekar aaye woh unke samne thi aur Aap ﷺ ke khule maujizaat bhi apni ankhon se dekh rahe the, phir bawajood in tamam baaton ke woh bhag rahe the aur toliyan toliyan ho kar dayen bayen katra jate the, jaise aur jagah ayat (Fama lahum anit-tazkirati mu'ridin) (Al-Muddassir: 49), yeh nasehat se munh pher kar un gadhoon ki tarah jo sher se bhag rahe hon kyun bhag rahe hain? Yahan bhi isi tarah farma raha hai ki un kuffar ko kya ho gaya hai yeh nafrat kar ke kyun tere paas se bhage ja rahe hain? Kyunki dayen bayen sarakte jate hain? Aur kya wajah hai ki mutafarriq taur par ikhtilaf ke sath idhar udhar ho rahe hain.

Hadhrat Imam Ahmad bin Hanbal ؒ ne khwahish-e-nafs par amal karne walon ke haq mein yahi farmaya hai ki woh Kitabullah ke mukhalif hote hain aur aapas mein bhi mukhtalif hote hain. Han Kitabullah ki mukhalifat mein sab muttafiqa hote hain.

Hadhrat Ibn Abbas R.A se bi-riwayat-e-Awfi marwi hai ki woh toliyan ho kar be-parwah ke sath tere dayen bayen ho kar tujhe mazaq se ghourte hain. Hadhrat Hasan farmate hain yani dayen bayen alag ho jate hain aur puchte hain ki is shakhs ne kya kaha? Hadhrat Qatadah farmate hain dayen bayen toliyan toliyan ho kar Huzoor ﷺ ke gird-o-pesh phirte rehte hain, na Kitabullah ki chahat hai na Rasulullah ﷺ ki raghbat hai.

Ek hadith mein hai ki Rasulullah ﷺ logon ke paas aaye aur woh mutafarriq taur par halqe halqe the toh farmaya: Main tumhein alag alag jamaton ki suraton mein kaise dekh raha hun? (Musnad Ahmad). Ibn Jarir mein aur sanad se bhi marwi hai.

Phir irshad hota hai ki kya inki chahat hai ki Jannat-e-Naeem mein dakhil kiye jayen? Aisa na hoga, yani jab inki yeh halat hai ki Kitabullah aur Rasulullah ﷺ se dayen bayen katra jate hain, phir inki yeh chahat poori nahi ho sakti balki yeh jahannami giroh hai.

Ab jis cheez ko yeh muhal jante the uska behtareen suboot unhi ke maloomat aur iqrar se bayan ho raha hai ki jis ne tumhein zaeef pani se paida kiya hai jaise ki khud tumhein bhi maloom hai, phir kya woh tumhein dobara nahi paida kar sakta? Jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Alam nakhluqkum min ma'in mahin) (Al-Mursalat: 20) kya hum ne tumhein na-qadre pani se paida nahi kiya? Farman hai ayat (Falyanzuril-insanu mimma khuliqa).

(At-Tariq: 5), Insaan ko dekhna chahiye ke woh kis cheez se paida kiya gaya hai, uchhalne wale pani se paida kiya gaya hai jo peeth aur chhati ke darmiyan se nikalta hai, yaqinan woh Allah uske lautane par qadir hai jis din poshidgiyan khul jayengi aur koi taaqat na hogi na madadgaar, pas yahan bhi farmata hai mujhe qasam hai uski jis ne zameen-o-asman ko paida kiya aur mashriq-o-maghrib mutaeen ki aur sitaron ke chhupne aur zahir hone ki jaghein muqarrar kar din, matlab yeh hai ke aye kafro! Jaisa tumhara guman hai waisa mamla nahi ke na hisab-kitab ho na hashr-nashar ho balkeh yeh sab yaqinan hone wali cheezein hain. Isi liye qasam se pehle unke batil khayal ki takzeeb ki aur use is tarah sabit kiya ke apni qudrat-e-kamila ke mukhtalif namuney unke samne pesh kiye, maslan asman-o-zameen ki ibtidai paidaish aur haywanat, jamadat aur mukhtalif qisam ki makhlooq ki maujudgi jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Lakh-alq-us-samawati wal-ardi akbaru min khalq-i-nnasi wa lakinna aksara nnasi la ya'lamun 57) (Ghafir: 57) yani asman-o-zameen ka paida karna logon ke paida karne se bahut bada hai lekin aksar log be-ilm hain, matlab yeh hai ke jab badi badi cheezon ko paida karne par Allah qadir hai toh chhoti cheezon ki paidaish par kyun qadir na hoga? Jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Awalam yarau anna Allaha allazi khalaqa as-samawati wal-arda wa lam ya'ya bi-khalqihin bi-qadirin ala an yuhyi al-mawta bala innahu ala kulli shay-in qadir 33) (Al-Ahqaf: 33) yani kya yeh nahi dekhte ke jis ne asmanon aur zameeno ko paida kiya aur unki paidaish mein na thaka kya woh murdon ko zinda karne par qadir nahi?
